# NBC Chicago

> > NBC Chicago (NBC 5) is the local NBC affiliate serving Chicago and Illinois with breaking news, weather forecasts, sports coverage, and Olympic content.

NBC Chicago delivers comprehensive local news coverage for the Chicago metropolitan area and Illinois, including weather updates, breaking alerts, community events, and exclusive Olympic sports content featuring figure skating stars like Amber Glenn and Ilia Malinin. As part of NBCUniversal Media, the station provides both local reporting and national Olympic coverage through NBC Olympics & Paralympics.

## Key Topics

- Chicago local news
- Illinois weather and breaking alerts
- 2026 Milan Cortina Winter Olympics
- Figure skating coverage
- Amber Glenn
- Ilia Malinin
- Johnny Weir and Tara Lipinski commentary
- St. Patrick's Day Chicago River dyeing
- Illinois elections 2026
- Peacock streaming
- Olympic performance highlights
- Chicago community events
- Winter sports coverage
- NBC Olympics & Paralympics
